body: AUDIT-7 Lane 4 suspect-closure pointer: #961 / PR #8049. PR #8049 flips `gopls-mcp-server` to worktree scope, but its body and issue comment #6780423113 explicitly leave the three-part live `go_package_api`/linked-worktree/distinct-instance proof outstanding until the daemon is redeployed. No later merged PR or issue comment supplies that proof; #961 closed on 2026-11-10 while the acceptance remained open. Lane 4 marks #8049 `audit:partial`; Lane 2 owns the closure review. No reopen was made.
